probe_provenance.purpose: Retain exact component probe code and clarify coverage; no new timing, estimator imports, tests or builds executed.

drivers.rerun_precondition: A baseline replay must use the archived baseline source/runtime environment; the same script run against a later installed extension measures that later extension.

probe_audit_scope.stage_probe: Independent float64 cdist/stable-index oracle checks the public neighbor results before component timing. Stage timers are attribution measurements; not every timed stage return is independently audited.
probe_audit_scope.ablation_probe: Every native selector result has squared distances and IDs checked against independent cdist/stable ordering; every engine result has IDs checked. Timed regressor predictions are not checked after each call. End-to-end precision is covered by separate tests. The raw ablation method shorthand each result independently audited is clarified here and in candidate-validation JSON.
probe_audit_scope.limits: Component timings do not establish GPU-control or universal speedup claims.

fallback_static_review.portable_python_fallback: tests/unit/test_neighbors_cpu_exact.py uses an autouse fixture disabling all four native hooks, including query_concentrated, integer selector and feature ranges; meaningful exact-order, bound, fractional-query and tiling tests execute without native help.
fallback_static_review.native_scalar_logic: Existing minimum-count late-winner tests and new malformed scalar-tail/mixed-error tests execute the scalar inner logic on ARM, alongside vector tests.
fallback_static_review.non_arm_native_build: No standalone non-ARM C++ build was executed. setup.py builds the native extension only on macOS arm64; normal non-ARM installations use portable Python. Full non-NEON native configuration should not be claimed tested.
fallback_static_review.static_correctness: The non-NEON k=5 path performs bounded-integer validation on every scalar before score arithmetic and pruning, tracks domain/negative errors globally, and uses the same staged commit. No static defect found.

documentation_hashes: Deferred to root final report QA; no mutable report text or figure is frozen by this record.
limits: Integrity/accuracy acceptance does not mean all benchmarks are faster or universally 2x faster.
Component probes are development evidence and are not pooled with completed final panels.
